signal: Unilog launched HyperScale, its suite of AI agents for B2B commerce and content across the CX1 platform

email.body1:
Gordon, saw Unilog rolled out HyperScale, your suite of AI agents across the CX1 platform.

Shipping AI that fast usually means more distributors and manufacturers worth a conversation than your team can actually reach before momentum cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Unilog off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Gordon, quick follow-up for Unilog.

When a platform team is selling into wholesale distributors at scale, most leaders can't say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Unilog needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Gordon, last bit of proof for Unilog.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Unilog's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Gordon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI suite is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your distribution motion? I'll tailor it to Unilog either way.
